display_long_description:
Slice to the beat. Build your combo. Beat your best score.

NEON KATANA is a fast-paced VR rhythm slashing game where you use two glowing katanas to slice colorful blocks to the music.

Red and blue blocks fly toward you in time . Match each block to the correct blade, time your swings, and slice them cleanly to build your combo and increase your score.

HOW IT PLAYS

Use your two glowing katanas to slice incoming blocks.

Red blocks must be cut with the red blade, while blue blocks must be cut with the blue blade.

Swing at the right moment. Accurate hits increase your score and help you maintain your combo.

Miss blocks or use the wrong blade and you lose health. When your health reaches zero, the game ends.

Keep playing until your health runs out.

FEATURES

• Two glowing katanas
• Red and blue color-matching gameplay
• Curving, spiraling, zigzag and straight target patterns
• Different target formations and patterns
• Combo system with score feedback
• Current score and personal best score
• Challenge yourself to beat your best score
• Results showing your performance
• Multiple songs to choose from
• Standing, stationary VR gameplay

PLAY YOUR WAY

Choose a song and try to beat your best score.

Improve your timing, maintain your combo, and see how accurately you can slice
